messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some engaging true or false questions to help students get to know your new teacher.

1. The teacher enjoys hiking on weekends.
2. They have a pet cat named Mochi.
3. Coffee is their favorite morning drink.
4. They traveled to Japan last year.
5. The teacher loves playing chess with friends.
6. They write poetry in their spare time.
7. Baking cookies is a hobby they enjoy.
8. They speak three languages fluently now.
9. The teacher collects vintage comic books often.
10. Swimming is their preferred exercise routine.
11. They enjoy reading mystery novels at night.
12. A guitar is an instrument they play.
13. They volunteer at local community centers.
14. Cooking pasta is their culinary specialty today.
15. The teacher has visited Paris twice before.
16. They love watching science fiction movies alone.
17. 彼ら (They) are very kind to everyone here.
18. The teacher plays tennis every Saturday morning.
19. They have a green bicycle for commuting.
20. Writing letters is a nostalgic activity for them.
21. The teacher enjoys gardening in springtime usually.
22. They listen to jazz music while working.
23. A dog is their other beloved family member.
24. They plan to learn Spanish next semester.
25. The teacher likes camping under the stars.
26. They collect rare stamps from different countries.
27. Dancing salsa is a fun activity for them.
28. The teacher reads fantasy novels frequently always.
29. They make homemade jam during summer breaks.
30. Visiting museums is a regular weekend tradition.
